reason: 5.17.6 fail-closed on governance that was already working. An OpenClaw workspace provisioned by dashclaw install codex inherited a governance block written for the wrong runtime: it told the agent to call dashclaw_session_start and dashclaw_guard through a dashclaw MCP server that OpenClaw never exposes, so an agent following its own instructions refused to act while the plugin was enforcing governance normally the whole time. New dashclaw install openclaw target installs and enables @dashclaw/openclaw-plugin, writes identity/URL/failClosed through one validated openclaw config patch (plugins.allow is left to plugins enable, because config patch replaces arrays wholesale), keeps the API key in ~/.openclaw/.env unless --write-config is passed, resolves the AGENTS.md target from agents.defaults.workspace rather than the cwd, and detects and replaces a codex-authored block behind a .dashclaw-bak backup. /guides/openclaw rewritten to teach the one command. Platform only, no Node/Python SDK surface change.
